name: TinyFish

env_keys.comment: Comparison only; anysearch does not read a key for this provider.

mode.comment: No named fast/balanced/deep search tiers; the single Search endpoint is configured by result count, domain_type and date filters.

notes: Comparison only; no anysearch SDK adapter is claimed.

requires_key.comment: All Search requests require the X-API-Key header.

snippet.comment: Every result exposes a snippet string alongside title, url and site_name.

domains.comment: include_domains and exclude_domains accept comma-separated domain lists; site: operators are deprecated in favour of these parameters.

country.comment: location takes a two-letter country code such as US or GB, defaults to US when omitted, and is resolved from language when only that is set.

language.comment: language takes a language code such as en or fr, defaults to en when omitted, and is resolved from location when only that is set.

date.comment: after_date and before_date accept YYYY-MM-DD and recency_minutes sets a freshness window; research-paper results use pub_year_min and pub_year_max instead.

safe_search.comment: No safe-search or adult-content parameter appears in the Search API reference; a 403 only reports an upstream policy rejection.

answer.comment: The Search response contains ranked links and snippets only; synthesized answers are not part of this scoped contract, and Agent and Research are separate products.

content.comment: Search returns snippets rather than page bodies; page content comes from the separate Fetch API at api.fetch.tinyfish.ai.

summary.comment: The documented Search response has no per-result or query-level summary field.

highlights.comment: Results expose plain snippet text with no highlight offsets or marked terms.

news.comment: domain_type=news returns news articles with publisher and date fields.

native_api.value: GET https://api.search.tinyfish.ai returns ranked web, news or research-paper results with title, snippet, URL, site name and news date. Supports include/exclude domains, location, language, recency and date bounds, an optional purpose hint, and pages 0-10. Separate Fetch, Agent, Research and Browser products share the same key.

rate_limits.value: 30 requests/min per API key by default (500 requests/hour on the pricing page); 12,000 free searches/day; HTTP 402 above the allowance when the wallet balance is zero

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.

pricing_per_1k.value: Search $0.00 per request; free up to 12,000 requests/day at 30 req/min, then a positive wallet balance is required
pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices.

primary_price.basis: Documented price is $0.00 per request; there is no paid per-1K search rate to rank

lowest_price.basis: $0 inside the 12,000 requests/day free allowance, so it stays unranked instead of sorting first

free_tier_limits.value: Search free within 30 requests/min and 12,000 requests/day (resets 00:00 UTC); Fetch free to 1,000 URLs/day; no card required
free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct.
